
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

setwd("C:/Users/danie/OneDrive/Skrivebord/Digitale arkiver og metoder/Final product projekter/Final report Nicolai Danielsen")

data <- read_csv("Final-Projekt-Census-1801-1834.csv")

glimpse(data)
head(data)
names(data)

women <- data %>%
  filter(koen == "kvinde")


women <- women %>%
  mutate(age_group = case_when(
    alder >= 10 & alder < 20 ~ "10-20",
    alder >= 20 & alder < 30 ~ "20-30",
    alder >= 30 & alder < 40 ~ "30-40",
    alder >= 40 ~ "40+",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

table(women$age_group)

women$age_group <- factor(
  women$age_group,
  levels = c("10-20", "20-30", "30-40", "40+")
)


women_counts <- women %>%
  group_by(age_group, civilstand, ft) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

women_percent <- women %>%
  group_by(age_group, civilstand, ft) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(age_group, ft) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()


theme_journal <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )



p1 <- ggplot(women_counts,
             aes(x = age_group,
                 y = n,
                 fill = civilstand)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ ft, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Counts",
    x = "Age group",
    y = "Number of women"
  ) +
  theme_journal

p2 <- ggplot(women_percent,
             aes(x = age_group,
                 y = percent,
                 fill = civilstand)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ ft, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Percentages",
    x = "Age group",
    y = "Percent"
  ) +
  theme_journal

p1 + p2


women_20_30_marriage_pct <- women_percent %>%
  filter(age_group == "20-30")

p_marriage_20_30_pct <- ggplot(women_20_30_marriage_pct,
                               aes(x = civilstand,
                                   y = percent,
                                   fill = civilstand)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ ft, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Marriages between 20-30",
    x = "Marriage status",
    y = "Percent",
    fill = "Civilstand"
  ) +
  theme_journal +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p_marriage_20_30_pct)

p_marriage_30_40_pct <- ggplot(women_30_40_marriage_pct,

women_erhverv_ft_counts <- women %>%
  filter(!is.na(erhverv)) %>%
  group_by(erhverv, age_group, civilstand, ft) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

print(p_marriage_30_40_pct)

data_plot_1801 <- women %>%
  filter(age_group == "20-30", ft == 1801, !is.na(erhverv)) %>%
  group_by(erhverv, civilstand) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(erhverv) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_max(total, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)

p_erhverv_20_30_1801 <- ggplot(data_plot_1801,
                               aes(y = reorder(erhverv, total), x = n, fill = civilstand)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round((x / sum(data_plot_1801$n)) * 100, 1), "%")) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Most common occupations Age 20-30 1801",
    x = "Percent of Total Women",
    y = "Occupation (Erhverv)",
    fill = "Civilstand"
  ) +
  theme_journal +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_erhverv_20_30_1801)
